root_cause: reactions/api.ts serves loadReactions from a module-level in-memory cache (cache-first since c64fe0f to stop a badge-revival race). The S0 cross-tab channel (69b71d0) carried no 'reactions' store: reaction writes posted nothing and no receiver invalidated the reaction cache, so another open tab kept serving its stale cached rows until reload.
fix: crossTab: 'reactions' store. reactions/api.ts: enqueue posts store-changed {reactions, id: thread namespace key} after the IDB set settles (also on rejection: indeterminate, receiver only re-reads); clearDmReactionsForPeer / purgeStrangerDmReactions post per deleted key after delMany settles. New refreshReactionsFromStorage(key): queued on the thread's write queue (after this tab's in-flight writes, so a removal mid-write is never revived), re-reads that one thread into the cache and emits to its listeners; skipped for threads neither cached nor subscribed and during clearAllReactions; never rejects (failed read keeps cache, no emit); read-only, no post. loadReactions cold path no longer overwrites a cache entry filled while its read was in flight. crossTabReceiver maps 'reactions' (scoped only) to refreshReactions(id); MarmotContext wires it to refreshReactionsFromStorage. UI consumers (ChatStoreContext, useDirectReactions) already recompute on subscribeReactions emits — unchanged.
deviations_from_design: Reactions post after a settled (incl. rejected) IDB write, unlike the S0 writers (success only): a rejected IndexedDB write is indeterminate and the receiver only re-reads stored state. Recorded in api.ts#announce and the crossTab.ts contract comment.
Scope extended to the peer wipes and the cold-load overwrite guard (same stale-cache class).
No e2e spec added (optional per brief; not runnable by the fixer). dm-block-cross-tab.spec.ts is the pattern if the lead wants a two-page dm-*/groups-* check.
tests_added: tests/unit/reactions/crossTab-reactions.test.ts (new, 21 tests): two tabs = two module instances (vi.resetModules) over one Map-backed idb-keyval and a simulated BroadcastChannel bus (no echo to sender), wired through the real crossTabReceiver. Propagation: inbound group add [success signal], own DM add/remove/rollback, inbound removal, no-op writes post nothing, receiver never posts. Scoping: only the announced thread re-read / its listeners fire, uncached+unsubscribed thread not read, subscribed-but-uncached refreshed, uncached refresh is a resolved no-op, skipped during clearAllReactions (wiped account not re-cached). Badge revival: refresh mid-removal never revives; a settled refresh never unchains a later queued write; cold load never overwrites a newer cache. Failure injection: set rejects (notice still posted, other tab shows stored truth), set commits-then-rejects (other tab shows it), refresh read fails (cache kept, no emit, resolves, queue not wedged), postMessage throws (write succeeds), clearDmReactionsForPeer / purge delMany rejects (notice posted, stored truth shown).

tests/unit/crossTab.test.ts (+4): 'reactions' accepted by parseStoreChanged and mapped to exactly refreshReactions (it.each), scoped id passed through, unscoped notice refreshes nothing, MarmotContext wiring source-scan includes refreshReactionsFromStorage(key).

open_questions: Follow-up (lead filing): enqueue sets the cache BEFORE the IDB set; if the set rejects, this tab's cache keeps the unpersisted rows until reload.

Browsers without Web Locks: a simultaneous cross-tab write to one thread can still be lost (pinned by test, documented in reactions-and-emoji.md section 8).

remediation_round_1.trigger: Reviewer ACCEPTED with docs condition (F1 sentence); Codex 1 high (cross-tab lost update revives a removed badge) + 2 medium (refresh storms; refresh racing a peer wipe = reviewer F2). Lead: do items 1-3.
fix: enqueue: each read-modify-write runs under navigator.locks.request('few:reactions:'+key) when Web Locks exist (webLocks() as in pollPersistence), inside the per-key in-tab queue (c64fe0f ordering unchanged); in-tab queue only otherwise.
refreshReactionsFromStorage coalesced per key (queuedRefreshes): at most one queued + one running; a notice while queued returns the queued promise.

Peer-wipe guard: wipesInProgress counter per key (beginWipe/endWipe in clearDmReactionsForPeer via new wipeDmReactionKeys helper, and purgeStrangerDmReactions, end in finally); the refresh skips cache.set/emit when a wipe of its key is in progress after its read.
docs/behavior/reactions-and-emoji.md section 8: guarantee stated for Web Locks; without them a simultaneous two-tab write can bring a removal back.
remediation_round_1.tests_added: crossTab-reactions.test.ts +15 (21 -> 36): reviewer scenario with shared fake Web Locks (storage + both caches = removal + heart; lock name) and without (lost update pinned); lock inside in-tab queue keeps same-tab order; coalescing (queued notices share one refresh / one read / one emit; notice while running queues exactly one more; 10-write storm bounded); wipe races (refresh during clearDm / purge delete never re-caches; overlapping wipes hold until the last ends; after each wipe a refresh caches + notifies again; each wipe waits for an in-flight write); Web Locks detection (locks without request, no navigator).
